tenderSchedule.title: Invitation for Expression of Interest for the Rate Contract for Glasswares, Chemicals, Labwares, Culture media, DNA sequencing pack, Molecular biology kits, Molecular biology enzymes, Sequencing service (Outsourcing),Primer synthesis etc
tenderSchedule.description: Invitation for Expression of Interest for the Rate Contract for Glasswares, Chemicals, Labwares, Culture media, DNA sequencing pack, Molecular biology kits, Molecular biology enzymes, Sequencing service (Outsourcing),Primer synthesis etc

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Agencies should have at least 5 years of experience in the field of supply of proposed items (as on the date of tender notification). This should be supported by the certificate issued by the competent authority. (Company registration certificate or similar document). GST Registration Certificate should also be enclosed

For the bidder is distributor / dealer / stockiest, it is mandatory to attach latest authorization certificate. The Manufacturer should indicate (upload) the nearest distributor / dealer / stockiest for the institute for supplying & billing.

The Agencies should have supplied successfully the GLASSWARES, CHEMICALS, LAB WARE etc., to the Government / Semi Government / PSUs/ Autonomous Institutions. In support of this, the agency shall furnish supply orders /work orders and satisfactory performance certificates for the preceeding 3 years-2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

The Agencies should furnish Annual turnover certificate for last 3 preceeding financial years issued from Chartered Accountant with UDIN No. for the years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The average annual turnover for preceding 3 years should be minimum 50 lakhs
Income Tax Returns- The tenderer should have submitted IT returns for the Last 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

The Agencies should have supplied the items worth Rs. 25 lakhs in case of Chemicals and Rs. 5 lakhs in case of Glasswares / Labwares / Plasticwares etc., in any one year in the past three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 to Government / Semi Government / PSUs / Autonomous Institutions. Agencies should enclose users list regarding supply of proposed notified items in the prescribed proforma supported by the concerned supply orders/ documents. As per detailed format attached.
An affidavit certified by the Notary in stamp paper Rs.100/- indicating the fact that the agency is not blacklisted by any Government /Quasi Government Organizations /Institutions/ Universities
It is desired that the Agency shall produce valid accreditation/ quality certificates issued by competent authorities
An expert committee will be constituted for tender evaluation and only technically valid tenders will be considered for empanelling
The Rate Contract will be valid for One year from the date of order of Rate Contract
Rate Contract can be extended for further period (S) on mutual consent on same terms and conditions

Annual Rate Contract for the items shall be based on the manufacturers price list. The Agencies shall compulsorily submit the hard copy of catalogue with detailed specification of the items with price to The Executive Officer (e-procurement & GeM), Estate Branch, University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad on or before the last date mentioned in the schedule of events. Failure to submit the same will lead to disqualification for participating in the Rate Contract. Information about Service support also shall be furnished by the agencies

The participating agencies shall compulsorily fill / indicate the % of rebate offered in the proforma uploaded. No further negotiation will be conducted. Agencies should mention their final rebate for the proposed items. As per the proforma sheet attached.
Quoted rebate amount in the tender should include all applicable taxes, transport charges, installation charges
The vendor who quotes the highest rebate will be considered for empanelling of rate contract

Transportation and freight charges insurance charges if any will not be paid by the purchaser. Similarly shortage pilferage in transit will be the sole responsibility of the supplier and the same will be intimated to the supplier within 15 days on receipt of goods by the purchaser to make goods the loss caused on this account.

The empanelled agencies shall enter into an agreement on a stamp paper of Rs. 500/- with UAS, Dharwad containing General / Special conditions of contract and also Security Deposit of Rs. 5,000.00 has to be paid by the agency within 15 days from the date of issue of letter of acceptance agreeing to the conditions of contract and providing service within the stipulated period
The price and rebate (Discount) should be fixed for the entire period of rate contract
The firms shall also furnish a certificate to the effect that they are not giving more discount to any other organization over and above accepted by the Institute
GST and other Government levies will be paid extra as applicable according to government regulations.
No revision in rate on higher side will be accepted. The price list already submitted / received in the office on the last date of submission of tender will be treated as final.
The delivery / supply will be made on FOR basis to UAS, Dharwad main campus including its all Colleges, Research Stations, KVKs, EEUs, Departments under the jurisdiction of UAS, Dharwad

The Companies shall supply the items required by the users within 10 days for Indian Chemicals / items and within 20 days for Imported Chemicals / items strictly in conformity with specifications and grade etc., In case of any delay in executing the contract, the supplier / firm shall promptly inform the institute in writing the fact of delay and duration of supply well before the expiry of the delivery period
Suppliers shall be fully responsible for any loss, damage or shortage of materials in transit. Necessary deduction shall be made from the bill, if any.
The packing of goods shall be as is required to prevent the material from damage or deterioration during transit to the final destination
All supplied items must have minimum shelf life / expiry date. Items supplied with shorter expiry period are likely to be rejected
Quality of the materials will be tested in the laboratories, if need be.

In case of perishable store, the rejected items should be replaced free of cost by the firms to the Institute. The packing of the goods should be good quality which is essentially required to prevent the material from any damage or deterioration during transit to their final destination
Suppliers shall adhere to the delivery period strictly mentioned in each purchase order. If they fail to do so, LD clause shall be applicable

If the firm fails to deliver the goods within the stipulated period for reasons other than circumstances beyond suppliers control and the institute extends the delivery period, the institute will also deduct from the contract price, as liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5 Percent per week subject to maximum of 10 Percent. Liquidated damages charges will be deducted only on basic cost (excluding GST) & the same may be reduced from the full amount of bill. Once the maximum is reached, the Institute may consider termination of PO. However in certain rare and genuine situation extension may be granted if the competent authority is satisfied and the request is received in the office within the stipulated period of supply.
Any dispute arising out of this contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the law of courts in Dharwad only
It is mandatory to enclose all the information asked in the technical evaluation criteria and it should be complete in all respects
